product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides pay-equity, pay-transparency, and regulatory-compliance software and services that help employers—especially global enterprises—analyze and manage fair, compliant pay across their workforces.
product_one_liner.notes: Product suite and intended enterprise employer customers are described on the company site.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage offers product and sales contact/demo routes but no public pricing page or pricing link.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations appear in Trusaic PayParity case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the 51–200 range; Tracxn gives a current count of 121 employees, placing Trusaic in the specified 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn company profile lists Los Angeles, California as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company announcement says Trusaic's foundation was established in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: Blog has multiple technical/product-building posts, including an account of building Trusaic AI and a further responsible-AI post.

public_docs.notes: The homepage/footer surfaced trust and resource material, but no public product documentation, help center, or developer portal with multiple product-support articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Careers page links to the job listing board; no evidence surfaced for an open AI/ML/data-science-titled role.

model_provider.value: Trusaic describes Trusaic AI as proprietary, trained on its own pay-equity/pay-transparency methodology; it does not publicly identify a third-party AI model or provider. The Trust Center names Microsoft Azure as a subprocessor, not as a model provider.
model_provider.notes: No named foundation model/provider found; Microsoft Azure is identified as a subprocessor only.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center identifies SOC 2 Type 2 and an ISO certificate; the company homepage states GDPR compliant. ISO 42001 is described elsewhere as planned/in development and is not included.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn identifies Trusaic as unfunded and reports no funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile describes the company as unfunded, with no rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page links to an external job listing, but the live roles were not available to verify titles; no assertion made.

launched_6mo.notes: The press center lists a 2026 launch of the enhanced EU Pay Transparency Directive Monitor with an interactive map, within the six-month window ending 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Trusaic announced Dawn Clements joined as Chief Sales Officer on October 24, within the prior 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These named platforms are listed on Trusaic's data integrations page; they are integrations, not necessarily internal CRM usage.
